Question 4

Find an equation of the plane that contains the point Q(3,2,0) and is perpendicular to the vector n=⟨1,−2,5⟩.

a
r⋅⟨1,−2,5⟩=⟨3,2,0⟩
b
r⋅⟨3,2,0⟩=−4
c
r⋅⟨1,−2,5⟩=−1
d

e
